bio: Eliana Heo First-Year Social Committee Elm Yard Hi! My name is Eliana Heo, and I am from Auckland, New Zealand! I am a first year living in Weld Hall, and plan to concentrate in Economics, with a potential secondary in either Government or Sociology. On campus, I am also a part of The College Events Board and sing with my acapella group, The Harvard Callbacks! I am super excited to be a part of the FYSC family and cannot wait to organize many exciting events for the Class of 2027! Feel free to reach out or say hi if you see me around!
